title.full: How to apply for a CPF top-up

summary.text: Choose the type of top-up you want, then follow its guide.

steps.name: Choose the top-up type
steps.text: Choose the option you need: recurring cash top-ups via GIRO, recurring CPF transfers to yourself if you are aged 55 or above, a one-time cash top-up, or a one-time CPF transfer.

steps.name: Follow the matching guide
steps.text: Use the guide for your chosen option. One-time cash top-ups can use PayNow QR, OCBC Digital in the CPF Mobile app, or the CPF Mobile app.

steps.name: Use Corppass if applicable
steps.text: If you are an employer or platform operator making cash top-ups for employees or platform workers, apply online using Corppass.
